title: 第1616章 韩家逼跪第1615章 九声响四位法王现
slug: 洪荒帝主第1616章韩家逼跪
content_zh:
突然，他目光一转，开口道：“会不会是当初在大日城阻挡我们那位女子，据说在妖市外已经突破了神祖？”
他顿了顿，“还是说是当初和慧闻大师一起来大日城久李天那位青衫男子，他可是神祖后期。”
他说完后殿中安静了片刻，每个人脸上显现出凝重。
大宝法王坐在正中蒲团上，开口：“丹增是追着那个李天出去的，不是追着别人。如果当时有其他人在场，桑吉回来说的话里应该会提到。”
仁钦点了点头：“桑吉只提到了李天一个人，没有提到其他人。”
嘉措看向大宝法王：“那会不会是李天自己动的手？他身可是宝物众多。”
大宝法王沉默了片刻：“宝物再厉害，但要跨一个大境界杀神祖，光靠宝物不够，最多只能保命。如果他还有其他手段，确实有可能。”
桑杰没有说话，但目光落在大宝法王身上，像是在等一个更明确的判断。大宝法王又沉默了片刻：“不管是哪一种可能，这件事都跟李天脱不开关系。”
大宝法王的话音落下后，殿中安静了片刻。
桑杰的声音打破了沉默：“那现在怎么办？丹增死了，人估计已经到中洲了。中洲那边，我们插不上手。”
仁钦接过话：“插不上手也得查，丹增的死，密宗不能就这么算了。”
他目光看向扎元，“你多多努力，争取突破到神祖境，现在法王殿交由你管理。”
扎元听到仁钦的话，沉默了片刻，然后开口：“弟子修为尚浅，恐怕难以服众。北方法王殿的弟子中，不乏修为高于弟子之人。”
仁钦的目光在他脸上停了一下：“你是首座，丹增在时你是首座，丹增不在了你也是首座。修为不够可以就努力，威望不够可以立。法王殿现在需要一个能稳住局面的人，不是需要一个修为最高的人。”
扎元没有再推辞，合十行礼：“弟子尽力。”
仁钦没有再看他，目光转向大宝法王：“那屏障那边，还要继续查吗？”
大宝法王沉默了片刻：“查。派人在屏障附近守着，如果他能从那边回来，或者有人从中洲过来，第一时间传讯。”
他顿了顿，“另外，派人去大雷音寺那边盯着。他在西洲的时候，和大雷音寺的人有来往。”
嘉措点了点头：“我去安排。”
大宝法王站起身，没有再说什么，朝殿门外走去。

其余三位法王也站起身，跟在他身后。
四道身影先后掠入夜空，消失在夜色中。
殿中只剩下扎元一人站在门内侧，望着那些正在远去的方向，烛火在他身侧无声地跳动着。
他沉默了片刻，转身走出大殿，穿过广场朝自己的住处走去。
——
翌日清晨，天光大亮。
天枢城的街道在晨光中逐渐热闹起来，店铺陆续开门，行人在街道上往来。
李天从房间中走出时，雪瑶已经站在走廊尽头，像是已经在那里站了一会儿。
她看了李天一眼：“走吧。”
两人下楼，在客栈一楼大堂各要了一碗素面，没有多说什么，安静地吃完。
吃完后雪瑶在桌上放了几枚灵石，站起身：“出门转转，熟悉一下天枢城。”
李天点了点头，也站起身，跟着她走出客栈。
content_en:
Suddenly, he turned his eyes and said, "Could it be that the woman who blocked us in Dayi City was said to have broken through the Divine Ancestor outside the Demon City?"
He paused and said, "Or is it the man in blue shirt who came to Dauri City with Master Huiwen for a long time? He is in the later stage of the Divine Ancestor."
After he finished speaking, there was silence in the back hall for a moment, and everyone's face showed solemnity.
Karmapa Karmapa sat on the futon in the middle and said: "Tenzin went out after that Li Tian, not someone else. If there were other people present at the time, Sanji should have mentioned it in what he said when he came back."
Rinqin nodded: "Sangji only mentioned Li Tian and no one else."
Gyatso looked at Karmapa Karmapa: "Could it be Li Tian himself who did it? He has many treasures in his body."
Dharma King Karmapa was silent for a moment: "No matter how powerful the treasure is, if you want to cross a large realm to kill the ancestor of the gods, relying on treasures alone is not enough. At most, you can only save your life. If he has other means, it is indeed possible."
Sanjie said nothing, but his eyes fell on Karmapa, as if waiting for a clearer judgment. Karmapa Karmapa was silent for another moment: "No matter what the possibility is, this matter is inseparable from Li Tian."
After Karmapa finished speaking, the hall was quiet for a moment.
Sanjay's voice broke the silence: "What should we do now? Tenzin is dead, and he has probably arrived in Central Continent. We can't get involved in Central Continent."
Rinqin took over and said, "You still have to investigate even if you can't intervene. Tantric Buddhism cannot just let Tenzin's death go."
He looked at Zha Yuan and said, "Work hard and strive to break through to the Divine Ancestor Realm. Now the Dharma King's Palace is under your management."
After hearing Rinqin's words, Zha Yuan was silent for a moment, and then spoke: "My disciple's cultivation is still shallow, so I'm afraid it will be difficult to convince the public. Among the disciples of the Northern Fawang Palace, there are many people whose cultivation is higher than my disciples."
Rinqin's eyes paused on his face: "You are the leader. You were the leader when Tenzin was there, and you are the leader when Tenzin is gone. If your cultivation level is not enough, then work hard, and if your prestige is not enough, you can establish it. The Dharma King's Palace now needs someone who can stabilize the situation, not a person with the highest cultivation level."
Zha Yuan did not refuse any more, but put his hands together and saluted: "Disciple, do your best."
Rinqin did not look at him again, and turned to the Karmapa: "Do you want to continue to check the other side of the barrier?"
Karmapa Karmapa was silent for a moment: "Check. Send people to guard near the barrier. If he can come back from there, or if someone comes from Central China, send a message as soon as possible."
He paused and said, "In addition, send someone to watch over the Great Leiyin Temple. When he was in Xizhou, he had contact with the people from the Great Leiyin Temple."
Gyatso nodded: "I'll make arrangements."
Karmapa stood up and walked towards the door of the palace without saying anything else.
The other three Dharma Kings also stood up and followed behind him.
Four figures swept into the night sky one after another and disappeared into the night.
Zha Yuan was the only one left in the hall, standing on the inside of the door, looking at the people leaving in the direction, with the candlelight beating silently beside him.
He was silent for a moment, then turned and walked out of the hall, walking across the square towards his residence.
——
The next morning, the sky was bright.
The streets of Tianshu City gradually became lively in the morning light, shops opened one after another, and pedestrians were walking on the streets.
When Li Tian walked out of the room, Xueyao was already standing at the end of the corridor, as if she had been standing there for a while.
She glanced at Li Tian: "Let's go."
The two of them went downstairs and each ordered a bowl of plain noodles in the lobby on the first floor of the inn. They ate their meals quietly without saying anything else.
After eating, Xueyao placed a few spirit stones on the table and stood up: "Go out and walk around to get familiar with Tianshu City."
Li Tian nodded, stood up, and followed her out of the inn.
